metadata.question: Were the sea surface temperatures near the coast of La Jolla, California on August 1, 2018 higher than the same region's sea surface temperature the year prior?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use NOAA OISST (Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature) dataset in GEE, which provides daily SST data globally at ~25km resolution. - Location: La Jolla, California coast (approximately 32.85°N, -117.27°W). - Dates: August 1, 2018 vs. August 1, 2017. - Collect SST for both dates and compare mean temperatures in the coastal region. 2. **Masking strategy**: - SST data doesn't require cloud masking (it's a derived product from microwave data that penetrates clouds). - Just extract SST values for the region on both dates. 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error**: - Check if images exist for both dates (if not, output C1). - Check if valid pixels exist after extraction (if pixel count = 0, output C2). - Verify SST values are in valid range (~-2°C to 35°C for ocean). If NaN or out of range, output C3. - Compare: If 2018 SST > 2017 SST, answer A. Otherwise, answer B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define La Jolla, California coastal region const laJollaPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.27, 32.85]); const region = laJollaPoint.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around the point // NOAA OISST collection const sst = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/OISST/AVHRR/V02'); // Filter for August 1, 2018 and August 1, 2017 const sst2018 = sst.filterDate('2018-08-01', '2018-08-02') .select('sst'); const sst2017 = sst.filterDate('2017-08-01', '2017-08-02') .select('sst'); // Check data availability const size2018 = sst2018.size().getInfo(); const size2017 = sst2017.size().getInfo(); print(`2018 Images: ${size2018}`); print(`2017 Images: ${size2017}`); if (size2018 === 0 || size2017 === 0) { print('No data available for one or both dates.'); print('C1'); return; } // Get mean SST for both dates const img2018 = sst2018.first(); const img2017 = sst2017.first(); // Count valid pixels const count2018 = img2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); const count2017 = img2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); print(`Valid pixels 2018: ${count2018}, 2017: ${count2017}`); if (count2018 === 0 || count2017 === 0) { print('No valid pixels after processing.'); print('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean SST for each year (convert from Kelvin to Celsius) const meanSST2018 = img2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); const meanSST2017 = img2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius const sst2018C = meanSST2018 - 273.15; const sst2017C = meanSST2017 - 273.15; print(`2018 SST: ${sst2018C.toFixed(2)}°C`); print(`2017 SST: ${sst2017C.toFixed(2)}°C`); // Validate results if (sst2018C === null || sst2017C === null || isNaN(sst2018C) || isNaN(sst2017C) || sst2018C < -5 || sst2018C > 40 || sst2017C < -5 || sst2017C > 40) { print('Invalid SST values.'); print('C3'); return; } // Compare temperatures if (sst2018C > sst2017C) { print(`2018 was warmer (${(sst2018C - sst2017C).toFixed(2)}°C difference)`); print('A'); } else { print(`2018 was not warmer (${(sst2017C - sst2018C).toFixed(2)}°C cooler)`); print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
